newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Suntech to buy into Hemraj.
newsitem.headline: Thai Suntech to buy into Hemraj.

text.p: Thai scrap metal dealer Suntech Group said on Tuesday that it planned to invest in 14 million common shares of property firm Hemraj Land and Development Plc at 138 baht per share for a total of 1.93 billion baht.
It would raise its capital through the issue of new shares and use the proceeds to finance the purchase, it added in a filing to the Thai stock exchange.
Suntech said it would issue 97.5 million new shares at a par value of 10 baht each to raise its registered capital to 1.9 billion baht from the current 925 million baht.
The company added that it decided to undertake the transaction to spread risks of the company's business, boost revenues and get returns in the form of dividends.
It would hold an extraordinary shareholders meeting on March 3 to get approval for the planned purchase.
